if (phDragBlock && phDraggerButton && phCardsWrapper) {
  let isDragging = false;
  let startX = 0;
  let currentPercent = 0;
  
  const minPH = 0;
  const maxPH = 14;
  
  const calculateTotalWidth = () => {
    const cards = phCardsWrapper.querySelectorAll('.ph_details_card');
    const computedStyle = window.getComputedStyle(phCardsWrapper);
    const gap = parseFloat(computedStyle.columnGap || computedStyle.gap || '0');

      }
    });
    
    return width + (gap);
  };
  
  const getContainerWidth = () => {
    return phCardsWrapper.parentElement.offsetWidth;
  };
  
  const updateDragger = (percent) => {
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockWidth = phDragBlock.offsetWidth;
    const maxMove = blockWidth - buttonWidth;
    const moveX = (maxMove * percent) / 100;
    
    const wrapperWidth = calculateTotalWidth();
    const containerWidth = getContainerWidth();
    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, wrapperWidth - containerWidth);
    const scrollX = (maxScroll * percent) / 100;
    
    gsap.to(phDraggerButton, {
      x: moveX,
      duration: 0.1,
      overwrite: 'auto'
    });
    
    gsap.to(phCardsWrapper, {
      x: -scrollX,
      duration: 0.1,
      overwrite: 'auto'
    });

    moveX = Math.max(0, Math.min(moveX, maxMove));
    
    const percent = (moveX / maxMove) * 100;
    updateDragger(percent);
  });

    isDragging = false;
    phDraggerButton.style.cursor = 'grab';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'auto';
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'auto';
  });

    const blockRect = phDragBlock.getBoundingClientRect();
    const maxMove = phDragBlock.offsetWidth - buttonWidth;
    
    let moveX = e.clientX - blockRect.left - (buttonWidth / 2);
    moveX = Math.max(0, Math.min(moveX, maxMove));
    
    const percent = (moveX / maxMove) * 100;
    updateDragger(percent);
  });

    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'none';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'none';
    e.preventDefault();

<script>

  let isDragging = false;

    const gap = parseFloat(computedStyle.columnGap || computedStyle.gap || '0');
    let width = 0;
    
    cards.forEach((card, index) => {
      width += card.offsetWidth;
      if (index < cards.length - 1) {
        width += gap;
      }
    });
    
    return width + (gap);
  };
  
  const getContainerWidth = () => {
    return phCardsWrapper.parentElement.offsetWidth;
  };
  
  const updateDragger = (percent) => {
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockWidth = phDragBlock.offsetWidth;
    const maxMove = blockWidth - buttonWidth;
    const moveX = (maxMove * percent) / 100;
    
    const wrapperWidth = calculateTotalWidth();
    const containerWidth = getContainerWidth();
    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, wrapperWidth - containerWidth);
    const scrollX = (maxScroll * percent) / 100;
    
    gsap.to(phDraggerButton, {
      x: moveX,
      duration: 0.1,
      overwrite: 'auto'
    });
    
    gsap.to(phCardsWrapper, {
      x: -scrollX,
      duration: 0.1,
      overwrite: 'auto'
    });
    
    const ph = minPH + (maxPH - minPH) * (percent / 100);
    phNumber.textContent = Math.round(ph * 10) / 10;
    
    currentPercent = percent;
  };
  
  phDraggerButton.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    isDragging = true;
    startX = e.clientX;
    phDraggerButton.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'none';
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'none';
  });

    const maxMove = phDragBlock.offsetWidth - buttonWidth;

      }
      answer.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    });

    const answer = card.querySelector('.faq_answer');
    const svg = card.querySelector('.faq_svg');
    const gap = getGap();
    gsap.to(answer, {
      height: answerHeights[index],
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
    gsap.to(svg, {
      rotation: 180,
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
    gsap.to(card, {
      gap: gap,
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
  };

    const answer = card.querySelector('.faq_answer');
    const svg = card.querySelector('.faq_svg');
    gsap.to(answer, {
      height: 0,
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
    gsap.to(svg, {
      rotation: 0,
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
    gsap.to(card, {
      gap: '0rem',
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
  };

  const init = () => {
    calculateHeights();
    faqCards.forEach((card, index) => {
      const answer = card.querySelector('.faq_answer');
      const svg = card.querySelector('.faq_svg');
      answer.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      
      if (index === 0) {
        answer.style.height = answerHeights[0] + 'px';
        svg.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
        card.style.gap = getGap();
        currentOpenIndex = 0;

        answer.style.height = '0px';
        card.style.gap = '0rem';
      }

      card.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const isOpen = answer.offsetHeight > 0;
        
        if (isOpen) {
          closeCard(card, index);
        } else {
          if (currentOpenIndex !== index) {
            const previousCard = faqCards[currentOpenIndex];
            closeCard(previousCard, currentOpenIndex);
          }
          openCard(card, index);
          currentOpenIndex = index;
        }
      });
    });
  };

  window.addEventListener('load', init);
  
  let resizeTimeout;
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
    resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      calculateHeights();
    }, 250);
  });
}

const navbar = document.querySelector('.navbar');
const navButton = document.querySelector('.nav_button');
const hamburgerPaths = document.querySelectorAll('.nav_hamburger path');
let lastScrollY = 0;
let isNavbarHidden = false;

const isNavMenuOpen = () => {
  return navButton.classList.contains('w--open');

  if (isNavMenuOpen()) {
    hamburgerPaths.forEach(path => path.classList.add('is-open'));

    hamburgerPaths.forEach(path => path.classList.remove('is-open'));
  }

  setTimeout(updateHamburgerIcon, 10);
});

    setTimeout(updateHamburgerIcon, 10);
  });
}

  updateHamburgerIcon();
});

observer.observe(navButton, { 
  attributes: true, 
  attributeFilter: ['class'] 
});

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updateHamburgerIcon);

window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  const currentScrollY = window.scrollY;
  if (currentScrollY > 100) {
    navbar.classList.add('scrolled');

    navbar.classList.remove('scrolled');

        duration: 0.3,

<script>
const faqCards = document.querySelectorAll('.faq_card');
const faqWrapper = document.querySelector('.faq_cards_wrapper');
if (faqCards.length > 0 && faqWrapper) {
  const desktopGap = '1rem';
  const mobileGap = '0.5rem';
  const answerHeights = {};
  let currentOpenIndex = 0;
  const getGap = () => window.innerWidth < 768 ? mobileGap : desktopGap;
  
  const calculateHeights = () => {
    faqCards.forEach((card, index) => {
      const answer = card.querySelector('.faq_answer');
      const wasOpen = answer.offsetHeight > 0;
      answer.style.display = 'block';
      answer.style.height = 'auto';
      answerHeights[index] = answer.offsetHeight;
      if (wasOpen) {
        answer.style.height = answerHeights[index] + 'px';
      } else {
        answer.style.height = '0px';
      }
      answer.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    });
  };

  const openCard = (card, index) => {
    const answer = card.querySelector('.faq_answer');
    const svg = card.querySelector('.faq_svg');
    const gap = getGap();
    gsap.to(answer, {
      height: answerHeights[index],
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
    gsap.to(svg, {
      rotation: 180,
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
    gsap.to(card, {
      gap: gap,
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
  };

  const closeCard = (card, index) => {
    const answer = card.querySelector('.faq_answer');
    const svg = card.querySelector('.faq_svg');
    gsap.to(answer, {
      height: 0,
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
    gsap.to(svg, {
      rotation: 0,
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
    gsap.to(card, {
      gap: '0rem',
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
  };

  const init = () => {
    calculateHeights();
    faqCards.forEach((card, index) => {
      const answer = card.querySelector('.faq_answer');
      const svg = card.querySelector('.faq_svg');
      answer.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      
      if (index === 0) {
        answer.style.height = answerHeights[0] + 'px';
        svg.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
        card.style.gap = getGap();
        currentOpenIndex = 0;
      } else {
        answer.style.height = '0px';
        card.style.gap = '0rem';
      }

      card.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const isOpen = answer.offsetHeight > 0;
        
        if (isOpen) {
          closeCard(card, index);
        } else {
          if (currentOpenIndex !== index) {
            const previousCard = faqCards[currentOpenIndex];
            closeCard(previousCard, currentOpenIndex);
          }
          openCard(card, index);
          currentOpenIndex = index;
        }
      });
    });
  };

  window.addEventListener('load', init);
  
  let resizeTimeout;
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
    resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      calculateHeights();
    }, 250);
  });
}
</script>

<script>
const phDragBlock = document.querySelector('.ph_drag_block');
const phDraggerButton = document.querySelector('.ph_dragger_button');
const phNumber = document.querySelector('.ph-number');
const phCardsWrapper = document.querySelector('.ph_cards_wrapper');

if (phDragBlock && phDraggerButton && phCardsWrapper) {
  let isDragging = false;
  let startX = 0;
  let currentPercent = 0;
  
  const minPH = 0;
  const maxPH = 14;
  
  const calculateTotalWidth = () => {
    const cards = phCardsWrapper.querySelectorAll('.ph_details_card');
    const computedStyle = window.getComputedStyle(phCardsWrapper);
    const gap = parseFloat(computedStyle.columnGap || computedStyle.gap || '0');
    let width = 0;
    
    cards.forEach((card, index) => {
      width += card.offsetWidth;
      if (index < cards.length - 1) {
        width += gap;
      }
    });
    
    return width + (gap);
  };
  
  const getContainerWidth = () => {
    return phCardsWrapper.parentElement.offsetWidth;
  };
  
  const updateDragger = (percent) => {
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockWidth = phDragBlock.offsetWidth;
    const maxMove = blockWidth - buttonWidth;
    const moveX = (maxMove * percent) / 100;
    
    const wrapperWidth = calculateTotalWidth();
    const containerWidth = getContainerWidth();
    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, wrapperWidth - containerWidth);
    const scrollX = (maxScroll * percent) / 100;
    
    gsap.to(phDraggerButton, {
      x: moveX,
      duration: 0.1,
      overwrite: 'auto'
    });
    
    gsap.to(phCardsWrapper, {
      x: -scrollX,
      duration: 0.1,
      overwrite: 'auto'
    });
    
    const ph = minPH + (maxPH - minPH) * (percent / 100);
    phNumber.textContent = Math.round(ph * 10) / 10;
    
    currentPercent = percent;
  };
  
  phDraggerButton.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    isDragging = true;
    startX = e.clientX;
    phDraggerButton.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'none';
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'none';
  });
  
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockRect = phDragBlock.getBoundingClientRect();
    const maxMove = phDragBlock.offsetWidth - buttonWidth;
    
    let moveX = e.clientX - blockRect.left - (buttonWidth / 2);
    moveX = Math.max(0, Math.min(moveX, maxMove));
    
    const percent = (moveX / maxMove) * 100;
    updateDragger(percent);
  });
  
  document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
    isDragging = false;
    phDraggerButton.style.cursor = 'grab';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'auto';
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'auto';
  });
  
  phDragBlock.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (isDragging) return;
    
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockRect = phDragBlock.getBoundingClientRect();
    const maxMove = phDragBlock.offsetWidth - buttonWidth;
    
    let moveX = e.clientX - blockRect.left - (buttonWidth / 2);
    moveX = Math.max(0, Math.min(moveX, maxMove));
    
    const percent = (moveX / maxMove) * 100;
    updateDragger(percent);
  });
  
  phDraggerButton.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    isDragging = true;
    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'none';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'none';
    e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });
  
  document.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    
    e.preventDefault();
    
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockRect = phDragBlock.getBoundingClientRect();
    const maxMove = phDragBlock.offsetWidth - buttonWidth;
    
    let moveX = e.touches[0].clientX - blockRect.left - (buttonWidth / 2);
    moveX = Math.max(0, Math.min(moveX, maxMove));
    
    const percent = (moveX / maxMove) * 100;
    updateDragger(percent);
  }, { passive: false });
  
  document.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
    isDragging = false;
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'auto';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'auto';
  });
  
  phNumber.addEventListener('selectstart', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
  });
  
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    updateDragger(currentPercent);
  });
  
  updateDragger(0);
}
</script>

<script>
const phDragBlock = document.querySelector('.ph_drag_block');
const phDraggerButton = document.querySelector('.ph_dragger_button');
const phNumber = document.querySelector('.ph-number');
const phCardsWrapper = document.querySelector('.ph_cards_wrapper');

if (phDragBlock && phDraggerButton && phCardsWrapper) {
  let isDragging = false;
  let startX = 0;
  let currentPercent = 0;
  
  const minPH = 0;
  const maxPH = 14;
  
  const calculateTotalWidth = () => {
    const cards = phCardsWrapper.querySelectorAll('.ph_details_card');
    const computedStyle = window.getComputedStyle(phCardsWrapper);
    const gap = parseFloat(computedStyle.columnGap || computedStyle.gap || '0');
    let width = 0;
    
    cards.forEach((card, index) => {
      width += card.offsetWidth;
      if (index < cards.length - 1) {
        width += gap;
      }
    });
    
    return width + (gap);
  };
  
  const getContainerWidth = () => {
    return phCardsWrapper.parentElement.offsetWidth;
  };
  
  const updateDragger = (percent) => {
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockWidth = phDragBlock.offsetWidth;
    const maxMove = blockWidth - buttonWidth;
    const moveX = (maxMove * percent) / 100;
    
    const wrapperWidth = calculateTotalWidth();
    const containerWidth = getContainerWidth();
    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, wrapperWidth - containerWidth);
    const scrollX = (maxScroll * percent) / 100;
    
    gsap.to(phDraggerButton, {
      x: moveX,
      duration: 0.1,
      overwrite: 'auto'
    });
    
    gsap.to(phCardsWrapper, {
      x: -scrollX,
      duration: 0.1,
      overwrite: 'auto'
    });
    
    const ph = minPH + (maxPH - minPH) * (percent / 100);
    phNumber.textContent = Math.round(ph * 10) / 10;
    
    currentPercent = percent;
  };
  
  phDraggerButton.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    isDragging = true;
    startX = e.clientX;
    phDraggerButton.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'none';
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'none';
  });
  
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockRect = phDragBlock.getBoundingClientRect();
    const maxMove = phDragBlock.offsetWidth - buttonWidth;
    
    let moveX = e.clientX - blockRect.left - (buttonWidth / 2);
    moveX = Math.max(0, Math.min(moveX, maxMove));
    
    const percent = (moveX / maxMove) * 100;
    updateDragger(percent);
  });
  
  document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
    isDragging = false;
    phDraggerButton.style.cursor = 'grab';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'auto';
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'auto';
  });
  
  phDragBlock.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (isDragging) return;
    
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockRect = phDragBlock.getBoundingClientRect();
    const maxMove = phDragBlock.offsetWidth - buttonWidth;
    
    let moveX = e.clientX - blockRect.left - (buttonWidth / 2);
    moveX = Math.max(0, Math.min(moveX, maxMove));
    
    const percent = (moveX / maxMove) * 100;
    updateDragger(percent);
  });
  
  phDraggerButton.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    isDragging = true;
    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'none';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'none';
    e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });
  
  document.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    
    e.preventDefault();
    
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockRect = phDragBlock.getBoundingClientRect();
    const maxMove = phDragBlock.offsetWidth - buttonWidth;
    
    let moveX = e.touches[0].clientX - blockRect.left - (buttonWidth / 2);
    moveX = Math.max(0, Math.min(moveX, maxMove));
    
    const percent = (moveX / maxMove) * 100;
    updateDragger(percent);
  }, { passive: false });
  
  document.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
    isDragging = false;
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'auto';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'auto';
  });
  
  phNumber.addEventListener('selectstart', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
  });
  
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    updateDragger(currentPercent);
  });
  
  updateDragger(0);
}
</script>

<script>
const faqCards = document.querySelectorAll('.faq_card');
const faqWrapper = document.querySelector('.faq_cards_wrapper');
if (faqCards.length > 0 && faqWrapper) {
  const desktopGap = '1rem';
  const mobileGap = '0.5rem';
  const answerHeights = {};
  let currentOpenIndex = 0;
  const getGap = () => window.innerWidth < 768 ? mobileGap : desktopGap;
  
  const calculateHeights = () => {
    faqCards.forEach((card, index) => {
      const answer = card.querySelector('.faq_answer');
      const wasOpen = answer.offsetHeight > 0;
      answer.style.display = 'block';
      answer.style.height = 'auto';
      answerHeights[index] = answer.offsetHeight;
      if (wasOpen) {
        answer.style.height = answerHeights[index] + 'px';
      } else {
        answer.style.height = '0px';
      }
      answer.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    });
  };

  const openCard = (card, index) => {
    const answer = card.querySelector('.faq_answer');
    const svg = card.querySelector('.faq_svg');
    const gap = getGap();
    gsap.to(answer, {
      height: answerHeights[index],
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
    gsap.to(svg, {
      rotation: 180,
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
    gsap.to(card, {
      gap: gap,
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
  };

  const closeCard = (card, index) => {
    const answer = card.querySelector('.faq_answer');
    const svg = card.querySelector('.faq_svg');
    gsap.to(answer, {
      height: 0,
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
    gsap.to(svg, {
      rotation: 0,
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
    gsap.to(card, {
      gap: '0rem',
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'power2.inOut'
    });
  };

  const init = () => {
    calculateHeights();
    faqCards.forEach((card, index) => {
      const answer = card.querySelector('.faq_answer');
      const svg = card.querySelector('.faq_svg');
      answer.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      
      if (index === 0) {
        answer.style.height = answerHeights[0] + 'px';
        svg.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
        card.style.gap = getGap();
        currentOpenIndex = 0;
      } else {
        answer.style.height = '0px';
        card.style.gap = '0rem';
      }

      card.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const isOpen = answer.offsetHeight > 0;
        
        if (isOpen) {
          closeCard(card, index);
        } else {
          if (currentOpenIndex !== index) {
            const previousCard = faqCards[currentOpenIndex];
            closeCard(previousCard, currentOpenIndex);
          }
          openCard(card, index);
          currentOpenIndex = index;
        }
      });
    });
  };

  window.addEventListener('load', init);
  
  let resizeTimeout;
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
    resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      calculateHeights();
    }, 250);
  });
}
</script>

<script>
const phDragBlock = document.querySelector('.ph_drag_block');
const phDraggerButton = document.querySelector('.ph_dragger_button');
const phNumber = document.querySelector('.ph-number');
const phCardsWrapper = document.querySelector('.ph_cards_wrapper');
const prevBtn = document.querySelector('.ph-slider-arrow.is-previous');
const nextBtn = document.querySelector('.ph-slider-arrow.is-nextone');

if (phDragBlock && phDraggerButton && phCardsWrapper) {
  let isDragging = false;
  let currentCardIndex = 0;
  let snapPositions = [];

  const minPH = 0;
  const maxPH = 14;

  const getGap = () => {
    const computedStyle = window.getComputedStyle(phCardsWrapper);
    return parseFloat(computedStyle.columnGap || computedStyle.gap || '0');
  };

  const getContainerWidth = () => phCardsWrapper.parentElement.offsetWidth;

  const getTotalScrollWidth = () => {
    const cards = phCardsWrapper.querySelectorAll('.ph_details_card');
    const gap = getGap();
    let width = 0;
    cards.forEach((card, i) => {
      width += card.offsetWidth;
      if (i < cards.length - 1) width += gap;
    });
    return width + gap;
  };

  const buildSnapPositions = () => {
    const cards = phCardsWrapper.querySelectorAll('.ph_details_card');
    const gap = getGap();
    const containerWidth = getContainerWidth();
    const totalWidth = getTotalScrollWidth();
    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, totalWidth - containerWidth);

    snapPositions = [];
    let offset = 0;
    cards.forEach((card) => {
      snapPositions.push(Math.min(offset, maxScroll));
      offset += card.offsetWidth + gap;
    });
  };

  const scrollToIndex = (index) => {
    const cards = phCardsWrapper.querySelectorAll('.ph_details_card');
    index = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, cards.length - 1));
    currentCardIndex = index;

    const scrollX = snapPositions[index];
    const totalWidth = getTotalScrollWidth();
    const containerWidth = getContainerWidth();
    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, totalWidth - containerWidth);
    const percent = maxScroll === 0 ? 0 : (scrollX / maxScroll) * 100;

    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockWidth = phDragBlock.offsetWidth;
    const maxMove = blockWidth - buttonWidth;
    const moveX = (maxMove * percent) / 100;

    gsap.to(phDraggerButton, { x: moveX, duration: 0.3, overwrite: 'auto' });
    gsap.to(phCardsWrapper, { x: -scrollX, duration: 0.3, overwrite: 'auto' });

    const ph = minPH + (maxPH - minPH) * (percent / 100);
    phNumber.textContent = Math.round(ph * 10) / 10;
  };

  const getNearestCardIndex = (scrollX) => {
    let nearest = 0;
    let minDist = Infinity;
    snapPositions.forEach((pos, i) => {
      const dist = Math.abs(pos - scrollX);
      if (dist < minDist) {
        minDist = dist;
        nearest = i;
      }
    });
    return nearest;
  };

  const updateDraggerFromPercent = (percent) => {
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockWidth = phDragBlock.offsetWidth;
    const maxMove = blockWidth - buttonWidth;
    const moveX = (maxMove * percent) / 100;

    const totalWidth = getTotalScrollWidth();
    const containerWidth = getContainerWidth();
    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, totalWidth - containerWidth);
    const scrollX = (maxScroll * percent) / 100;

    gsap.to(phDraggerButton, { x: moveX, duration: 0.1, overwrite: 'auto' });
    gsap.to(phCardsWrapper, { x: -scrollX, duration: 0.1, overwrite: 'auto' });

    const ph = minPH + (maxPH - minPH) * (percent / 100);
    phNumber.textContent = Math.round(ph * 10) / 10;

    return scrollX;
  };

  phDraggerButton.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    isDragging = true;
    phDraggerButton.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'none';
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'none';
  });

  document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockRect = phDragBlock.getBoundingClientRect();
    const maxMove = phDragBlock.offsetWidth - buttonWidth;
    let moveX = e.clientX - blockRect.left - buttonWidth / 2;
    moveX = Math.max(0, Math.min(moveX, maxMove));
    const percent = (moveX / maxMove) * 100;
    updateDraggerFromPercent(percent);
  });

  document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    isDragging = false;
    phDraggerButton.style.cursor = 'grab';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'auto';
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'auto';

    const currentX = Math.abs(gsap.getProperty(phCardsWrapper, 'x'));
    currentCardIndex = getNearestCardIndex(currentX);
  });

  phDragBlock.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (isDragging) return;
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockRect = phDragBlock.getBoundingClientRect();
    const maxMove = phDragBlock.offsetWidth - buttonWidth;
    let moveX = e.clientX - blockRect.left - buttonWidth / 2;
    moveX = Math.max(0, Math.min(moveX, maxMove));
    const percent = (moveX / maxMove) * 100;
    const scrollX = updateDraggerFromPercent(percent);
    currentCardIndex = getNearestCardIndex(scrollX);
  });

  phDraggerButton.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    isDragging = true;
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'none';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'none';
    e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });

  document.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const buttonWidth = phDraggerButton.offsetWidth;
    const blockRect = phDragBlock.getBoundingClientRect();
    const maxMove = phDragBlock.offsetWidth - buttonWidth;
    let moveX = e.touches[0].clientX - blockRect.left - buttonWidth / 2;
    moveX = Math.max(0, Math.min(moveX, maxMove));
    const percent = (moveX / maxMove) * 100;
    updateDraggerFromPercent(percent);
  }, { passive: false });

  document.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    isDragging = false;
    phNumber.style.userSelect = 'auto';
    phDraggerButton.style.userSelect = 'auto';
    const currentX = Math.abs(gsap.getProperty(phCardsWrapper, 'x'));
    currentCardIndex = getNearestCardIndex(currentX);
  });

  phNumber.addEventListener('selectstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

  if (nextBtn) {
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIndex(currentCardIndex + 1));
  }

  if (prevBtn) {
    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIndex(currentCardIndex - 1));
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    buildSnapPositions();
    scrollToIndex(currentCardIndex);
  });

  buildSnapPositions();
  scrollToIndex(0);
}
</script>
